games.title: Pathforge
games.short_description: Race your runner across the grid while forging crystal blocks to reroute your rival.
games.description: Pathforge is a turn-based race on a glowing grid. Each turn you choose: step your runner one cell, or forge a crystal block on any free cell to lengthen your rival's route. You can never seal a runner in completely, so every block is a trade-off between slowing them down and saving blocks for later. Grab spark cells along the way to earn extra blocks. Play against an AI with three difficulty levels or challenge a friend on the same device.
instructions: Cyan starts at the bottom and must reach the top row. Magenta starts at the top and must reach the bottom row.
On your turn either move one cell (up, down, left or right) or forge one crystal block on an empty cell.
A block can never cut off every route to a goal. Invalid cells are not highlighted.
If your rival stands directly next to you, you may vault straight over them when the landing cell is free.
Step on a spark cell to collect it and gain one extra block.
First runner to reach their goal row wins.

controls.desktop: Click a highlighted cell to move. Press F (or the Forge button) to switch to block mode, then click an empty cell. Arrow keys / WASD move your runner. H shows your shortest path. U undoes.
controls.mobile: Tap a highlighted cell to move. Tap Forge, then tap an empty cell to place a block.

games.title: Neon Dodge
games.short_description: Weave a light-orb through falling bars, spinning shards and laser sweeps. How long can you last?
games.description: Neon Dodge is an endless survival game. Steer your orb around a dark arena while bars rain down, shards spin across the field and laser lines sweep after a short warning. Every few seconds the pace picks up. Collect energy cores for bonus points and chase your personal best, which is saved on your device.
instructions: Move your orb to avoid every obstacle. One hit ends the run.
Your score grows every second you survive. Energy cores give a +50 bonus.
A flashing line warns you where a laser is about to fire. Get clear before it turns solid.
The game speeds up every 15 seconds.
Press P or Esc to pause at any time.

controls.desktop: Arrow keys or WASD to move. P / Esc to pause. Enter or R to restart after a crash.
controls.mobile: Touch and drag anywhere. The orb follows your finger's movement, so your finger never covers it.

games.title: Chroma Shift
games.short_description: Tap a tile to shift its color and its neighbors'. Turn the whole board one color before you run out of moves.
games.description: Chroma Shift is a color-matching logic puzzle. Tapping a tile shifts it and the four tiles touching it one step along the color wheel. Your goal is to make every tile the same color within the move limit. Boards grow larger and use more colors as you progress through 30 levels. Your unlocked levels and stars are saved on your device. Every color also has its own symbol, so you can play without telling colors apart.
instructions: Tap a tile: it and its up/down/left/right neighbors move one step along the color wheel shown above the board.
Make every tile the same color. Any color counts.
Finish within the move limit to clear the level. Fewer moves earn more stars.
Stuck? Use a hint. It highlights a useful tile but caps the level at 2 stars.
Your progress is saved automatically on this device.

controls.desktop: Click a tile. Arrow keys move the focus and Enter/Space taps. R restarts the level.

games.title: Highway Rush
games.short_description: Weave through four lanes of traffic, grab coins and survive as the highway keeps speeding up.
games.description: Highway Rush is a top-down endless racer. Your car keeps accelerating while rows of traffic fill the lanes ahead. Every row leaves a gap you can reach, but at higher speeds you need to read the road early. Collect coins for bonus points, earn extra points for close passes, and set a best score on each of three difficulty levels.
instructions: Steer between the four lanes to avoid every car. One crash ends the run.
Your speed increases the longer you drive. The traffic always leaves at least one gap you can reach.
Collect coins for +25 points. Passing a car in the next lane over is a near miss worth +5.
Score = meters driven + coin and near-miss bonuses. Each difficulty keeps its own best score.
Press P or Esc to pause.

controls.desktop: Left/Right arrows or A/D to steer. P / Esc to pause. Enter or R to drive again after a crash.
controls.mobile: Hold the on-screen arrow buttons, or touch and drag on the road to steer toward your finger.

games.title: Brick Breaker
games.short_description: Bounce the ball, smash every brick and catch power-ups across 8 hand-made levels.
games.description: Brick Breaker is a paddle-and-ball arcade game. Angle your shots by hitting the ball with different parts of the paddle, chip through bricks that take one to three hits, and work around steel bricks that never break. Catch falling power-ups for a wider paddle, extra balls, a slower ball or an extra life. You have three lives to clear all 8 levels.
instructions: Move the paddle to keep the ball in play. Launch the ball with Space, a click or a tap.
Where the ball hits the paddle sets its angle: the centre sends it straight up, the edges send it sideways.
Orange bricks break in one hit, yellow in two, red in three. Grey steel bricks never break. Green bricks always drop a power-up.
Power-ups: W wider paddle, M two extra balls, S slower ball, ♥ extra life (up to 5).
Losing every ball costs a life. Clear all breakable bricks to finish a level.

controls.desktop: Move the mouse or use Left/Right arrows (A/D). Space or click to launch. P / Esc to pause.
controls.mobile: Drag anywhere on the screen to move the paddle. Tap to launch the ball.

games.title: Fruit Slice
games.short_description: Swipe through flying fruit for 60 seconds, chain combos and dodge the bombs.
games.description: Fruit Slice is a 60-second swipe game. Fruit is tossed up from the bottom of the screen in growing waves; slash through it with your finger or mouse. Slicing several pieces in one quick swipe builds a combo multiplier of up to five times, and rare star fruit is worth triple. Bombs appear more often as the round goes on, and each one you hit takes five seconds off the clock.
instructions: Swipe across fruit to slice it. Each fruit is worth 1 point; star fruit is worth 3.
Slice fruit in quick succession for a combo: the second piece scores x2, the third x3, up to x5.
Bombs (dark circles marked ✕) cost 5 seconds and reset your combo.
The round lasts 60 seconds. Your best score is saved on this device.
Press P or Esc to pause.

controls.desktop: Hold the left mouse button and swipe across fruit. P / Esc to pause. Enter or R to play again.
controls.mobile: Swipe with your finger across the fruit.

games.title: Space Shooter
games.short_description: Blast through enemy waves, upgrade three weapons and take down a boss every fifth wave.
games.description: Space Shooter is a vertical wave shooter. Drones dive straight down, zig-zaggers weave and shoot back, and armoured tanks soak up damage. Every fifth wave a boss arrives with two attack phases. Collect pick-ups to switch between the rapid blaster, the wide spread gun and the piercing pulse cannon, and grab the same weapon again to upgrade it to level 3. Repair kits and shields help you survive as the waves get harder.
instructions: Fly your ship around the lower half of the screen and shoot everything that comes down.
Auto-fire is on by default; turn it off on the title screen (or press F) to fire with Space instead.
Collect pick-ups: B blaster, S spread, P pulse (pierces through enemies), + repair, O shield.
Picking up the weapon you already have upgrades it, up to level 3. Heavy hits can knock a level off.
Every fifth wave is a boss. When its health bar is below half it changes its attack pattern.
Your hull bar is shown at the top. The run ends when it reaches zero.

controls.desktop: Arrow keys or WASD to fly, Space to fire, F toggles auto-fire, P / Esc pauses. You can also drag with the mouse.
controls.mobile: Drag anywhere on the screen. The ship follows your finger's movement so your finger never covers it. Auto-fire is on.

games.title: Memory Match
games.short_description: Flip cards two at a time and find every pair, alone against the clock or against a friend.
games.description: Memory Match is a classic card-pairs game with three board sizes. Every symbol has its own shape and colour, so you never need to tell colours apart. Play solo to beat your best score, which rewards fewer moves and a faster time, or pass the device back and forth with a friend: find a pair and you go again, miss and it's their turn.
instructions: Flip two cards. If they show the same symbol they stay face up; if not, they turn back over.
Find every pair to finish the board.
Solo: fewer moves and a faster time give a higher score. Finish within the move target for 3 stars.
2 players: take turns on one device. Finding a pair earns a point and another turn. Most pairs wins.
Boards: Easy 4×3 (6 pairs), Medium 4×4 (8 pairs), Hard 6×5 (15 pairs).

controls.desktop: Click a card to flip it, or use the arrow keys to move between cards and Enter/Space to flip. Esc or P opens the menu.
controls.mobile: Tap a card to flip it.

games.title: Tic Tac Toe
games.short_description: Three in a row against a friend or a computer opponent with easy, medium and an unbeatable hard mode.
games.description: The classic 3×3 game of noughts and crosses. Play a friend on the same device or take on the computer: easy makes plenty of mistakes, medium always takes a win and blocks yours, and hard plays perfectly and cannot be beaten. The first move alternates every round and a scoreboard keeps track of wins and draws for the session.
instructions: Players take turns placing X and O on the 3×3 grid.
The first to get three in a row (across, down or diagonally) wins the round.
If all nine squares fill up with no line, the round is a draw.
Who moves first alternates every round. The scoreboard counts wins and draws until you reset it.
Against the computer, pick Easy, Medium or Hard. Hard never loses: a draw is a great result.

controls.desktop: Click a square, or move with the arrow keys and press Enter/Space. Esc opens the menu.

games.title: Snake Arena
games.short_description: Steer the snake, eat to grow and survive as it speeds up inside a walled arena.
games.description: Snake Arena is a take on the classic snake game. Guide your snake around a 20×20 walled arena, eat food to grow longer and pick up gold bonus food before it vanishes. The snake speeds up every four meals, so the arena gets crowded fast. Choose relaxed, classic or fast speed; each keeps its own best score.
instructions: The snake moves on its own. Change its direction to reach the red food.
Each meal is worth 10 points and makes the snake one segment longer.
Every 5th meal a gold bonus appears for a few seconds: +50 points and 3 extra segments.
Hitting a wall or your own body ends the game. You cannot reverse straight back into yourself.
The snake speeds up every 4 meals.

controls.desktop: Arrow keys or WASD to steer. P, Space or Esc to pause. Enter or R to play again.
controls.mobile: Swipe on the arena or use the on-screen arrow pad.

games.title: Tile Fusion
games.short_description: Slide numbered tiles, fuse equal pairs and build your way up to the 2048 tile.
games.description: Tile Fusion is a sliding-merge number puzzle on a 4×4 grid. Every swipe moves all the tiles at once; when two tiles with the same number collide they fuse into one tile worth double. A new 2 or 4 appears after every move, so plan ahead to keep space free. Reach the 2048 tile to win, then keep going for a higher score. You get three undos per game, and an unfinished game is saved on your device.
instructions: Swipe or press an arrow key: every tile slides as far as it can in that direction.
Two tiles with the same number that collide fuse into one tile with their sum. Each fusion adds that value to your score.
After every move a new 2 (sometimes a 4) appears in an empty square.
Reach a 2048 tile to win. You can keep playing after that.
The game ends when the grid is full and no neighbouring tiles match. You have 3 undos per game.

controls.desktop: Arrow keys or WASD to slide. Z or U to undo.
controls.mobile: Swipe on the grid to slide. Tap Undo to take back a move.

games.title: Tower Builder
games.short_description: Time each drop to stack sliding blocks into the tallest tower you can. Overhangs get sliced off.
games.description: Tower Builder is a one-tap timing game. A block slides back and forth above your tower; drop it so it lands on the floor below. Whatever hangs over the edge is sliced off and falls away, so each mistake leaves you a narrower block to work with. Line a block up exactly for a perfect drop, which scores bonus points, and chain three perfects to widen your block again. The blocks slide faster as the tower grows.
instructions: Tap, click or press Space to drop the sliding block.
Only the part that lands on the floor below stays. The overhang is sliced off.
A perfect drop (almost exactly lined up) keeps the full width and earns a streak bonus of up to +5.
Three perfect drops in a row make your block a little wider again.
Miss the tower completely and the game ends. Blocks speed up as you build higher.

controls.desktop: Click anywhere or press Space / Enter / Down arrow to drop.
